name: Tafindel
about: Tafindel is the son of Redshire's president, held by the Arctics after Redshire is annexed. The book gives no age or appearance, so this look is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: The president's son, Tafindel, is believed to be in Arctic captivity.
drop down a rope for him to tie around his waist and hold on to
facts.fact: Male; physically able to hold on to a rope during a rescue.

facts.quote: They were both wearing thermal cloaks.
facts.fact: Wears a thermal cloak during the rescue.

facts.quote: Tafindel is recommending that we play a little bit of hardball.
facts.fact: Later gives political recommendations, which suggests an adult.

descriptor: a young man in his early twenties, of medium build, deep brown skin, short black hair in tight coils with a neat side part, clean-shaven and composed, wearing a dark navy tailored tunic coat with a tall sculpted standing collar and a short half-cape over one shoulder, a crisp white seamless undershirt, grey slim trousers and black seamless boots
sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet on a plain flat off-white background with no scenery: three full-body views of the same person side by side, front view facing the viewer, three-quarter view, and back view, neutral standing pose, even lighting. The person is a young man in his early twenties, of medium build, deep brown skin, short black hair in tight coils with a neat side part, clean-shaven and composed, wearing a dark navy tailored tunic coat with a tall sculpted standing collar and a short half-cape over one shoulder, a crisp white seamless undershirt, grey slim trousers and black seamless boots.
costume_notes: A tall-collared tunic coat with a half-cape gives the president's son a formal Redshire look, and the half-cape nods to the thermal cloak he wears in the rescue.
